$comment: Which model and reasoning effort each role runs on. Read by the orchestrator (/sprint wave, /sprint train) and passed to workflow scripts; the agent definitions in .claude/agents/ carry the same defaults, so the two must be changed together. Use tier aliases (sonnet | opus | fable | haiku) — never dated model ids. Rule of thumb: volume work on the cheaper tier, judgment on the stronger one, and never a model stronger than the one that will have to arbitrate its disputes. executor.standard / executor.complex are chosen per sprint by its frontmatter `tier:`. escalation lists, in order, where an executor that returns ESCALATE is re-dispatched; past the end of the list the sprint is parked for the user.
